on the BICYCLE with SELECT (registered in 08.03) outside the store

checkpoint: From the Eevee's ball in Celadon Mansion's roof room (09.04), PokeGuy's way (1:02:18 to 1:04:11) to Lavender Town's Pokemon Center: X items on the Department Store's 5F, by its lift both ways (scripted as the Rocket Hideout's: the lift has no map, its doors' warps are dynamic), HM02 FLY from the woman in Route 16's house, taught to the Pidgey (08.03's catch), and Fly to Lavender.

Route 16 (Route16 map.json): from Celadon the east end (33..47, 12..14) is closed west by the Snorlax (31, 13), so the way north is the Cut tree (41, 11), then the north gate (Route16_NorthEntrance_1F) to the house (10, 5). Lea (30, 5) and Jed (31, 5) face south with sight 1; the grass (33..41, 5..7) is walked round. The bikers (6..16, 12..14) are south of the house's part of the route, behind the gate.
The woman wanders (MOVEMENT_TYPE_WANDER_AROUND, 3..5 by 2..3): the wanderer TALK presses A at (4, 3) until she is on it.
